restriction.android:title: Enrollment token
restriction.android:description: Token issued by the management portal. Redeemed once at first contact and then cleared, so a cloned image cannot enrol twice.

restriction.android:title: Serial number or asset tag
restriction.android:description: The identifier technicians search this device by. Preferred over the hardware serial, which an ordinary app cannot read on Android 10 and later. Left empty, the client falls back to the hardware serial if it is readable, then to ANDROID_ID.

restriction.android:title: API server
restriction.android:description: Management API base URL, for example https://odv.example.com. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.

restriction.android:title: ID server
restriction.android:description: Rendezvous server host. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.

restriction.android:title: Relay server
restriction.android:description: Relay server host. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.

restriction.android:title: Server public key
restriction.android:description: Deployment public key. Ignored on a build that already has its deployment baked in.
